rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinning zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying a compact grade-A ICM and cohesive grade-A TE from this image, and likely overinterprets vacuoles/vesicles not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, male-factor context, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible prognosis estimate, though some deductions rely on uncertain image features and the recommendation for PGT-A is somewhat stronger than the rest of the case supports.

SET recommendation and general counseling align well with ASRM/ESHRE principles, but stronger endorsement of PGT-A, ERA, DHEA, and some adjuncts goes beyond routine guideline-based recommendations for this favorable young patient.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, though a few suggestions are broader than necessary and include optional tests/interventions with limited routine indication.
